alternatives.description: Keep WP-005 without a machine validator for the >=3-family review boundary and keep branch-push conformance scoped to only HEAD^..HEAD.
alternatives.projected_effect: Human discipline remains the main guard at public/private intake, and a multi-commit branch can cause CI to lose sight of its governed production action/receipts.
alternatives.risk: Under-reviewed evidence or fragmented branch history can be misclassified by the integration path; optional absent receipt directories can also break durable-audit construction.

alternatives.description: Add the deterministic v15.5/source-root-bound review-bundle intake guard, audit the complete branch delta against its base, and make durable-audit receipt collection safe when an optional absolute receipt directory is absent.
alternatives.projected_effect: Public review evidence is machine-rejectable before private semantic consideration and each material branch change remains traceable to its governed action/receipts across multiple commits.
alternatives.risk: The guard validates transport/provenance rather than truth, and GitHub artifact retention still does not establish permanent protected archival.

bidirectional_gaps.gap: DO_NOTHING lacks executable enforcement of the new review threshold/zero-cost provenance and can audit only the latest branch commit rather than the governed branch delta.
The closure adds schema/CI coupling and still cannot substitute for five-file cross-reference, semantic proof, permanent archival, or ActionGate admission.

assumptions: Public review bundles are untrusted candidate evidence until independently validated and cross-referenced.
Reviewer agreement and transport validity do not establish proof or authority.
A feature-branch material change must be evaluated against its repository base rather than only its latest commit.
reason.uncertainty: A structurally valid review bundle may still contain correlated reasoning errors; GitHub artifact retention is finite and protected permanent cross-run archival remains FRONTIER.
counterexamples: A bundle with only two independent families must be rejected.
A finding without a matching successful provider call must be rejected.
A successful call whose cost is absent or nonzero must be rejected.
A bundle that claims semantic admission must be rejected.
A bundle bound to another DesignEpoch/source root must be rejected.
A multi-commit feature branch whose final commit edits only an AAP receipt must still find the production action and complete reasoning/algebra/AAP set from earlier branch commits.
An absent optional absolute gate-receipt directory must not crash durable-audit collection or be treated as a repository glob.
reason.conclusion: Admit only a candidate-evidence intake guard plus fail-closed whole-branch conformance/audit plumbing; preserve five-file cross-reference, ActionGate and human/canonical boundaries downstream.

obligations.statement: The validator rejects fewer than three independent/final reviewer families.
Reviewer findings/final dispositions bind to matching successful :free provider calls with explicit zero cost.
Stale DesignEpoch/source-root and self-admitting bundles fail closed.
Feature-branch conformance and ActionGate evaluate the complete origin/main..HEAD governed delta, not only HEAD^..HEAD.
Absent optional absolute receipt paths do not crash durable-audit collection and all available receipts remain hash-chained.
Passing intake and CI conformance remain non-authorizing and cannot modify canonical/current.

items.claim_scope: Public findings are candidate-only and require complete-source cross-reference.
Evolution evidence must remain durably/tamper-evidently auditable without converting missing optional stages into hidden success.
Repo-wide CI must enforce the governed trace over the full material change.
Requires >=3 independent reviewers on the same target before semantic admission and zero-cost external inference.
Current private predecessor remains the authority/canonical baseline.
